known_limits: Catalogue maturity label follows CRID P05023. Raster quality is unexamined.
ASF states that mixing data maturities can introduce processing differences.
GCOV pixel spacing is a posting. It is not independent spatial resolution.
The GCOV mask describes the adaptive multi-looking ensemble, not water.
The GSLC mask is the layer documented for water and shadow-layover.
Backscatter contrast, layover at the lake, numberOfLooks, and RFI cannot be judged until the HDF5 is opened.

outstanding_uncertainties: The study coordinate is a secondary published location, not a surveyed lake polygon.
Bounding-box intersection alone is not study-point coverage.
No science file was opened, so geolocation, speckle, and mask values at the lake are unknown.
S-band rasters inside joint-observation HDF5 files were not inspected.
At least one granule has CMR ORBIT_TYPE that does not match the filename orbit-fidelity letter defined in the ASF naming convention. Both values are kept. See filename_metadata_agreement.
The rank-1 D40 pair is a catalogue shortlist only and remains pending raster quality control.

statement: This file is a catalogue record from NASA CMR metadata. It is not evidence that a scientific measurement succeeded. No HDF5 or GeoTIFF file was downloaded. The recommended pair is pending raster quality control.

study_point.source: SANDRP commentary, 22 November 2024. Secondary-source location, not a survey-grade coordinate.

validated_p05036_same_mode.recommendation: Fewer than two validated P05036 acquisitions share the D40 geometry, bandwidth, polarization, and study-point coverage. No validated pair is recommended.
